title: Rosaceous
summary: ROSA'CEOUS, a s as z. [Latin rosaceus. See Rose.] Rose-like; composed of several petals, arranged in a circular form; as a rosaceous corol.

inlines.v: ROSA'CEOUS, a s as z. [Latin rosaceus. See Rose.] Rose-like; composed of several petals, arranged in a circular form; as a rosaceous corol.
